headline: On October 17, 2018: Canada legalizes recreational cannabis
captionCards: Cannabis Act and Bill C-46 passed in 2018
Regulates production, distribution, and personal use
instagramCaption:
Canada makes history with the Cannabis Act. \\[On October 17, 2018, Canada legalized the recreational use of cannabis through the Cannabis Act, alongside Bill C-46. This law marked a significant shift from the 1923 prohibition. The act not only allowed for personal use but also regulated production and distribution. Today, it continues to shape the legal and economic landscape of the country. What do you think about the impact of this law? Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳.
